title: China to pump $54bn into state banks and insurers to boost economy
summary: China is injecting $54 billion into state banks and insurers as part of efforts to reshape its economy amid various economic challenges, aiming to strengthen financial institutions and support economic growth.
content: It comes as Beijing is aiming to reshape its economy in the face of a number of challenges.

zh.title: 中国向国有银行和保险公司注入540亿美元以促进经济增长
zh.summary: 中国向国有银行和保险公司注入540亿美元，作为在各种经济挑战中重塑经济的努力的一部分，旨在加强金融机构并支持经济增长。

title: Asia-Pacific markets open higher as investors assess renewed Middle East  hostilities
summary: Asia-Pacific stock markets opened higher Monday following positive momentum from Friday's trading, as investors weigh the impact of renewed Middle East tensions on global financial markets.
content: Asia-Pacific markets open broadly higher on Monday, after they closed mostly in the green from the last trading session on Friday.

zh.title: 亚太市场走高，投资者评估中东局势恶化
zh.summary: 亚太股市周一开盘走高，延续周五交易的积极势头，投资者评估中东紧张局势重新升级对全球金融市场的影响。

title: Goldman boosts Asia ex-Japan index target for one big reason
summary: Goldman Sachs has raised its forecast for the MSCI Asia-Pacific ex-Japan Index, citing expectations for stronger earnings growth driven primarily by Taiwan and South Korea.
content: Goldman raises its forecast for MSCI AC Asia Pacific ex-Japan Index on expectations for higher earnings forecasts led by Taiwan and Korea.

zh.title: 高盛因一个重要原因提高亚洲除日本外指数目标
zh.summary: 高盛提高了MSCI亚太指数（除日本外）的预测，理由是预期收益增长强劲，主要由台湾和韩国驱动。

title: Treasury yields face 4.8% test as fiscal risks threaten to spill into other assets
summary: U.S. Treasury yields are testing the 4.8% level, with analysts warning that sustained yields above this threshold could create significant ripple effects across other financial markets and asset classes.
content: Treasury yields face a test at 4.8%, with a sustained move above that potentially creating "meaningful problems" for other asset classes, said Miller Tabak.

zh.title: 美国国债收益率面临4.8%考验，财政风险威胁蔓延至其他资产
zh.summary: 美国国债收益率正在测试4.8%的水平，分析师警告持续高于这一阈值的收益率可能会对其他金融市场和资产类别产生重大连锁反应。

title: Volcano eruption disrupts hundreds of flights at Southeast Asia's second-busiest airport
summary: Mount Anak Krakatau's eruption has disrupted hundreds of flights at Southeast Asia's second-busiest airport in Indonesia, with cancellations continuing through Monday.
content: Mount Anak Krakatau’s eruption disrupted hundreds of flights across Indonesia, with flight cancellations extending into Monday.

zh.title: 火山喷发导致东南亚第二繁忙机场数百架航班受阻
zh.summary: 阿纳克火山的喷发已导致东南亚第二繁忙机场（位于印尼）的数百架航班受阻，取消航班情况将持续到周一。

title: Five dead after Amazon cargo plane crashes at Miami airport
summary: A Boeing 767-300 cargo plane crashed at Miami airport, with five people killed and five seriously injured after the aircraft overran the runway and caught fire.
content: Five people are dead and five seriously injured after a Boeing 767-300 cargo plane "overran" the runway and caught fire, officials say.

zh.title: 亚马逊货运飞机在迈阿密机场坠毁，五人遇难
zh.summary: 一架波音767-300货运飞机在迈阿密机场坠毁，飞机冲出跑道并起火，造成五人死亡，五人重伤。

title: Data centers in space: Four big obstacles and Elon Musk's ambitious timeline
summary: The article examines major technical, regulatory, and logistical challenges facing Elon Musk's ambitious plans to deploy operational data centers in space.
